name: pwd
purpose: Print Working Directory — displays the current folder path you are working in inside the terminal.
explanation: Outputs the full absolute path from the root of the filesystem (/) to your current working directory. Use it whenever you are unsure where you are located.
whenToUse: Whenever you want to confirm your exact current directory inside the terminal.
commonMistakes: Confusing relative paths with the absolute path output by pwd.
explanationOfOutput: Shows the simulated terminal response when running `pwd` in a standard Unix-like shell.
commonErrors: zsh: command not found: pwd (if not installed or missing from PATH)
